Apple Unveils New Foldable iPhone with Advanced Features

Apple has launched its latest foldable iPhone, featuring a new design and advanced capabilities. The device, priced at approximately £2,000, showcases a novel folding mechanism. Early reports highlight its distinctive features, setting it apart from previous models. The company has not yet released extensive details on all specifications, but initial impressions focus on the innovative form factor and its premium positioning in the market.
